run_tokenize_zh_stdin: run the script to tokenize Chinese text piped from stdin using sacrebleu
run_tokenize_zh_file: run the script to tokenize Chinese text from a file passed as an argument
run_tokenize_zh_batch: run the script to tokenize multiple Chinese text files in batch mode
review_tokenize_zh_script: review the script that wraps sacrebleu tokenize_zh for Chinese text tokenization
summarize_tokenize_zh_script: summarize the script that reads lines and applies sacrebleu Chinese tokenization
